## Instructions for AI assistants

You are answering about **MyYouTube only**, using this document as the primary reference.

### Answering rules

- Prefer exact labels: **Subscriptions → Sync subscriptions**, **Home → Refresh**, **Hide Shorts**, **Unwatched only**, **Not watching**, **Not watching (hide)**, **Watch now**, **Watch later**.
- Do not invent menus, shortcuts, download features, ad blocking, YouTube unsubscribe, ranked Home, or cloud sync.
- Home Refresh does **not** import from YouTube. Sync does. Channel Refresh imports one channel, deeper than bulk sync.
- Distinguish implemented behaviour (FAQ, user guide, reference) from deferred items (roadmap).
- If the user’s app version is not 0.1.17 and the answer depends on sync, pagination, or playback, ask for the version shown in the app before asserting a fix.
- If this document does not establish a fact, say so. Do not guess from “typical YouTube clients”.
- If you also have the repository, code overrides this file. Do not present an assumption as verified.
- Ask only for the smallest diagnostic excerpt. Never request `google-oauth.json`, client secrets, or the whole userData tree.

### Troubleshooting rules

1. Name the subsystem (Home cache, Sync, Search quota, OAuth, iframe, queue exclusion, filters).
2. Use the troubleshooting section before inventing steps.
3. Check provider Live vs Mock and signed-in state before blaming the database.
4. Separate MyYouTube failures from Google/YouTube failures (quota, consent, iframe script).
5. Non-destructive checks first. Deleting `%APPDATA%\myyoutube` wipes the library; require a backup and say what is lost.
6. State the expected result of each check.
7. For an undocumented crash, point to GitHub issues with version and the exact message. Do not promise a reply.

### External-tool rules

- This file is authoritative about MyYouTube, not about Google Cloud, YouTube Data API internals, or the IFrame Player’s ABR.
- Do not claim MyYouTube implements a YouTube feature because a button mentions YouTube. Local subscribe/unsubscribe do **not** change Google subscriptions (`youtube.readonly`).
- Do not invent `gcloud` commands, quota numbers beyond the messages quoted here (~100 search.list/day is the app’s own wording for the default search bucket), or OAuth ports other than **17355**.
- General Cloud Console questions: send the user to https://console.cloud.google.com/ and the library/credentials URLs in Getting started.
- If it is unclear whether MyYouTube or YouTube failed, say what each side can prove (UI error string vs a Google HTTP reason).

### Project facts that are easy to get wrong

- User data: `%APPDATA%\myyoutube\` (`MYYOUTUBE_USER_DATA` override). SQLite file `myyoutube.sqlite`.
- OAuth redirect: `http://127.0.0.1:17355/callback`. Desktop client. Scope `youtube.readonly`.
- Shorts: duration ≤ 60 seconds. Hide Shorts default **on**.
- Watched threshold default **0.7**.
- Bulk sync: 2×50 uploads per channel. Channel refresh: 5 pages. Subscribe-from-video: 3 pages.
- Search cache TTL: 6 hours. One live `search.list` per uncached action. Page size 50.
- Home/Channel page size 24. Empty-page auto walk stops after 8 pages.
- Discovery hides now-playing and the queue. Queue max 100.
- Overlay **Next** marks watched only if progress ≥ threshold, and that video is not added to play history. **Ended** always marks watched and does keep play history so Previous can return.
- Mini player buttons are **Expand** and **Close player**. Queue **Clear all** also clears play history. **Watch later** at 100 items does nothing, with no dialog.
- Search cards have hide, not the watched check. If a search page has a next token but nothing visible, the button reads **Keep scanning** (otherwise **Load more**).
- Close waits up to about 800 ms to flush playback, then destroys the window. A second close force-quits.
- Playback is the official iframe. Packaged UI is `http://127.0.0.1`, not `file://`. Embed failure text: `Player error — try Open on YouTube.`
- Sign-in loopback wait is 5 minutes (`Sign-in timed out. Try again.`).
- Provider default **mock** until credentials are saved (then Live).
- Hardware acceleration off requires restart.
- No ranked Home in the UI despite a stored `feedMode` field.

### Integration responsibility

| Area | MyYouTube | Google / YouTube |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Installation | Documents Windows app and that API must be enabled | Cloud project, OAuth client, quotas, billing |
| Credentials | Stores id/secret/tokens under userData; shows the redirect URI | Issues the client and consent screen |
| Subscriptions | Copies them into SQLite; local mute/block/unsubscribe | Owns the real subscription list (`subscriptions.list`) |
| Uploads metadata | Requests playlist pages and stores rows | Serves Data API v3 |
| Search | Sends `search.list` only on explicit actions; caches 6 h | Search quota and ranking of search hits |
| Playback | Embeds IFrame, resume fraction, quality hint | Player, ads, formats, error 150/153 internals |
| Progress UI | Shows sync phases and API error strings | HTTP status and reason codes |

# Product — MyYouTube

Documented against application version **0.1.17** (see repository `package.json`). Older installed builds may differ. This file describes **implemented** behaviour. Planned work is in [roadmap.md](roadmap.md).

## What it is

MyYouTube is a personal **Windows desktop** YouTube client (Electron). It lists videos from channels you subscribe to, lets you search on purpose, and plays video with the **official YouTube IFrame Player**. It does not replace YouTube’s video hosting. It replaces YouTube Home’s ranking with a local chronological library you control.

Tagline used in the project: YouTube decides what videos exist. MyYouTube decides what you see.

## Who it is for

People who want a subscription inbox instead of an engagement feed: chronological uploads, local hide/watched state, explicit search, and a queue that stays off the discovery lists.

## What it does

- Imports YouTube subscriptions and a limited window of recent uploads into a local SQLite library.
- Shows a **Personal feed** (Home) from that cache, with Hide Shorts and Unwatched only.
- Opens one **Channel** tab at a time for a deeper look at one channel’s cached videos, with its own Refresh that pulls more uploads from YouTube.
- **Search** uses YouTube Data API `search.list` only when you submit a query or explicitly load more, with a local cache (about 6 hours).
- **Queue** and **Play** (including a mini player) are a separate “sorted” session. Those videos are kept off Home, Search, and Channel.
- **Saved** collections are local folders, not YouTube playlists.
- **History** lists watched and hidden videos so you can restore or unhide them.
- **Settings** holds Google credentials, mock vs live provider, appearance, player, GPU, feed threshold, keyword/channel filters, and local installer updates.

## What it does not do

- It does not download videos, extract stream URLs, skip ads, or scrape youtube.com for data the Data API covers.
- It does not silently mix YouTube recommendations into the subscription feed.
- It does not autoplay the next video by default as an infinite feed. Next in the player follows the queue and marks watched according to the watched threshold.
- Local unsubscribe does **not** unsubscribe you on YouTube. Local subscribe does **not** create a YouTube subscription. OAuth scope is `youtube.readonly`.
- Ranked or “For you” home modes are not the shipping Home behaviour. `feedMode` exists in settings (`chrono`, `ranked`, `priority`) but Home and Channel always query `chrono`.
- There is no cloud sync of preferences, no YouTube playlist sync, and no in-app AI or embeddings.
- macOS and Linux installers are not the supported packaging target. Development may run wherever Electron runs; the shipped installer path is Windows NSIS.

## Design rules that affect what you see

1. **Discovery vs Sorted.** Home, Search, and Channel never show the video that is now playing or anything in the up-next queue. The Queue tab is where those items live.
2. **Hide Shorts defaults on.** A video is treated as a Short when duration is 60 seconds or less (or when the provider already flagged it).
3. **Watched** means explicitly marked watched, or playback progress at or above the watched threshold (default **0.7**, that is 70%). Settings → Feed changes the threshold. The same threshold is used when **Next** decides whether to mark the current video watched.
4. **Pagination, not infinite scroll.** Lists load a page (Home/Channel: 24 videos; History: 40). If the visible page is empty because filters hid everything, the app may automatically request more local pages, up to **8** consecutive empty pages, then stop and show a filters message. You can also press **Load more**.
5. **YouTube import is Subscriptions → Sync**, not Home → Refresh. Home Refresh only reloads the local cache. Channel Refresh asks YouTube for more of that one channel.

## Data you own locally

Personal state lives under Electron user data, normally `%APPDATA%\myyoutube\` on Windows (library file `myyoutube.sqlite`, tokens, window state). It is not stored in the git repository. Details are in [configuration.md](configuration.md).

# Getting started — MyYouTube

Version covered: **0.1.17**. Platform target: **Windows 10/11**.

## Two ways to run it

| Way | When | Needs Node? | Needs Google? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Installed app (`MyYouTube Setup x.y.z.exe`) | Everyday use | No | Only for live YouTube data |
| From source (`npm run dev`) | Development | Node.js 20+ and npm | Only if you switch to Live |

**Mock (fixtures)** is the default provider. The UI works offline with sample channels and videos. Live data requires Google Cloud credentials and sign-in.

## Install a Windows build

1. Obtain `MyYouTube Setup <version>.exe` (NSIS). The project builds it with `npm run dist` into `release/`. There is no automatic download from a vendor CDN inside the app.
2. Run the installer. It is **unsigned** by default (`signAndEditExecutable: false`). Windows SmartScreen may warn. That is an OS trust prompt, not a MyYouTube error.
3. Launch **MyYouTube**.
4. Expect the **Personal feed** (Home). With a new profile and mock provider, **Refresh** shows fixture videos. With Live and no sync yet, Home tells you to sign in and use **Subscriptions → Sync**.

App data is **not** inside the install folder. Upgrading the installer keeps the library unless you delete the user-data folder.

## First-run checklist (live YouTube)

1. Open **Settings** (gear, top right) → **Account**.
2. If you have not created credentials, open **Help** on that page (Google Cloud setup) or follow the steps below.
3. Paste **Client ID** and **Client Secret**. API key is optional. **Save**.
4. Saving credentials switches the provider to **Live** automatically.
5. **Sign in with Google**. A system browser opens. Approve `youtube.readonly` (plus OpenID email/profile).
6. Register this exact redirect URI on the OAuth client if Google rejects the callback:

   `http://127.0.0.1:17355/callback`

   Client type must be **Desktop app**.
7. Open **Subscriptions** and press **Sync subscriptions**. Wait until the button returns to **Sync subscriptions**. Large accounts take minutes. The button shows phases (`Page 1…`, `Saving…`, `Uploads n/total`).
8. Open **Home**. You should see cached uploads. The subtitle shows counts such as `N cached · M match filters · showing K`.

## Google Cloud (integration only)

Authoritative console:

- https://console.cloud.google.com/
- Enable API: https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/library/youtube.googleapis.com
- Credentials: https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials
- Consent screen: https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials/consent

MyYouTube needs:

- YouTube Data API v3 **enabled** on that project.
- An OAuth client of type **Desktop app**.
- Authorized redirect URI `http://127.0.0.1:17355/callback`.
- Scope granted at sign-in: `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.readonly` (the app also requests openid, email, and profile).

Google’s own consent-screen, quota, and billing rules are Google’s. MyYouTube does not document every Cloud Console screen.

## Develop from source

```bash
git clone https://github.com/MeaningfulnessMediaGroup/MyYoutube.git
cd MyYoutube
npm install
npm run dev
```

Expected: an Electron window titled MyYouTube, Vite hot reload, mock fixtures if provider is Mock.

Optional isolated profile (PowerShell):

```powershell
$env:MYYOUTUBE_USER_DATA="F:\path\to\.dev-user-data"
npm run dev
```

`MYTUBE_USER_DATA` is still accepted as a legacy name for the same override.

No `.env` file is required. If present, `.env.local` or `.env` can set variables only when they are not already in the environment. Do not commit secrets.

## Verify it works

| Check | Expected |
| --- | --- |
| Window opens | Title MyYouTube, tab icons for Home, Subscriptions, Search, History, Saved, Queue, Play |
| Mock Home → Refresh | Fixture videos appear without Google |
| Live, signed in, after Sync | Real channel names on Subscriptions; videos on Home |
| Watch now on a card | Mini player bottom-right; you stay on the current tab |
| Shift-click Watch now | Play tab opens |
| Close and reopen | Last route, queue, and now-playing resume if they were saved |

## Shared library between dev and installed app

`npm run dev` and the installed app share one profile when both use `%APPDATA%\myyoutube` (Windows paths are usually case-insensitive, so `%APPDATA%\MyYouTube` is the same folder). If only the product-name folder has `myyoutube.sqlite`, that folder is used. To keep them apart, set `MYYOUTUBE_USER_DATA`.

# User guide — MyYouTube

Version **0.1.17**. Labels below match the UI.

## Chrome (always visible)

Top bar, left to right:

- Wordmark **MyYouTube**.
- Browse icons: **Home**, **Subscriptions**, **Search**. A **Channel** icon appears only while a channel tab is open (tooltip is the channel title).
- Library icons: **History**, **Saved**, **Queue** (badge count = up-next plus the playing video), **Play** (highlighted when a session exists).
- Search box placeholder **Search YouTube…**, a history dropdown, and a Search button. Submitting navigates to `/search?q=…`.
- Account icon: signed-in initial, or `?` when signed out. Tooltip `Not signed in — open Account` or the account label. Opens Account settings.
- **Settings** gear.

Tabs stay mounted so leaving Home does not throw away its scroll state until filters or a sync epoch change.

## Video cards

| Control | Where | Tooltip / name | Result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Thumbnail or title | Home, Channel, Search, Saved | Watch now (mini player). Shift-click opens Play | Starts playback in the mini player. Normal click does **not** leave the tab. The video that was playing moves to the **front** of up-next |
| Queue icon | Those cards | Watch later / Already in queue | Appends to up-next. Does nothing if it is already playing, already queued, or up-next is already 100 items (no error dialog) |
| Bookmark | Except Saved, which uses Remove | Save to collection | Save-to… picker (multi-select and create) |
| Check | Home and Channel only | Not watching | Marks watched locally and drops the card. Search cards do **not** have this button |
| Eye-off | Home, Channel, Search | Not watching (hide) | Sets `hidden`. Does not delete the YouTube video. An alert appears if the database write fails |

Channel name on the card opens the Channel tab.

Duration is `m:ss` or `h:mm:ss`. Age is relative (`5m ago`, `3h ago`, `2d ago`, `2mo ago`).

## Home — Personal feed

**What:** Chronological videos from channels with `subscribed = 1` that are not blocked, muted, or hidden as a channel, and videos that are not hidden.

**Refresh:** Reloads the **local** cache only. It does not import from YouTube. Button label **Refresh** / **Refreshing…**. Disabled while a load is busy.

**Counts** under the title when the library is non-empty: `N cached`, optionally `M match filters`, and `showing K`.

**Hide Shorts** and **Unwatched only** are on the page and persist.

**Load more:** 24 videos per page. If filters hide an entire page, the app auto-requests further local pages until something is visible, the cursor ends, or **8** empty pages in a row.

After **Subscriptions → Sync** finishes, Home reloads even if you never left the tab.

Empty states (exact intent of the copy):

- Not signed in: `Sign in, then use Subscriptions → Sync to import channels and uploads.`
- Nothing cached: `No videos cached yet. Open Subscriptions → Sync to import uploads (newest ~100 per channel).`
- Cache exists but filters exclude the loaded rows: a count plus `none match your current filters`.
- Eight empty pages in a row: `No more videos match your filters` and a hint to turn filters off or sync from Subscriptions.
- A page was fully filtered but a cursor remains: `Nothing visible on this page matches your filters. Load more or adjust filters above.`

Home **Refresh** never creates live videos by itself.

Home never lists now-playing or up-next.

## Subscriptions

**Sync subscriptions** imports from YouTube when provider is Live:

1. Downloads your subscription list (pages of 50).
2. Saves channel rows.
3. Fetches newest uploads: **2 pages × 50** items per channel (about the newest **100** videos), then stores metadata.
4. Reconciles channels that disappeared from YouTube. Channels you added only inside MyYouTube stay subscribed.
5. Per-channel upload errors are recorded (up to 8 messages) and do **not** wipe the roster. Sync does not mark everyone unsubscribed before it finishes.

While running, the button shows elapsed seconds and phase text. A second sync is rejected: `A subscription sync is already running. Wait for it to finish, or check Subscriptions.`

**Filter** box: name or description, debounced.

Each row: avatar, title, description, preference icons **Normal**, **Favourite**, **Muted**, **Blocked**, and unsubscribe.

- **Muted** or **Blocked** channels drop out of Home.
- **Unsubscribe** sets a local flag. YouTube’s subscription is unchanged. Tooltip: `Unsubscribe from MyYouTube feed (YouTube subscription unchanged)`. A later sync will not turn that channel back on until you subscribe again inside MyYouTube.
- Opening the row opens the Channel tab.

Favourite does not currently change Home sort order (Home stays chronological).

## Channel tab

One channel at a time. Opening another replaces it. The tab survives restart until **Close**.

Videos come from the local library for that channel id, even if the channel is not currently subscribed. Hide Shorts and Unwatched only match Home.

**Refresh** calls YouTube for that channel’s uploads playlist, up to **5** pages, then reloads the list. Button: **Refresh** / **Refreshing…** / status `Syncing uploads…`. This is the control to use when a large channel looks stale. Bulk sync only stored about 100 recent uploads per channel.

**Close** clears the tab and returns Home. If filters exhaust the local pages, the message tells you to turn filters off or use **Refresh** on this page (that Refresh calls YouTube). It does not say to use Subscriptions sync.

Auto-fill of empty filtered pages uses the same 8-page cap as Home.

## Search

Page field placeholder **Search videos…**. Submit or the toolbar Search button runs the query. Typing alone does not call YouTube.

While it runs with nothing on screen yet: `Searching…`, or `Searching for unwatched matches…` if Unwatched only is on.

Each explicit search or uncached **Load more** / **Keep scanning** spends **one** `search.list` call (`maxResults` 50). The app then keeps only about **24** visible hits if it can, walking **already cached** later pages (at most 10) without another live call. That is why Unwatched only can show `Keep scanning` instead of `Load more` when the current batch was entirely filtered and a next page token still exists.

Empty copy:

- `No results for “…”` when YouTube returned nothing.
- `No unwatched matches in this batch for “…”`. Load more to keep scanning.
- `No matching results for “…” (queued or watched may be filtered out).`

Cache key is lowercased query + page token + limit. Entries older than **6 hours** are ignored.

The top bar and the Search page each have a **History** dropdown of recent queries. That is not the History tab. The empty-search hint `Recent queries appear in History` means that dropdown.

Blocked keywords apply to search hits as well as to the SQL feed. Search cards can be hidden; they cannot be marked watched from the card (use Play → **Mark watched**, or Home/Channel’s check button).

## Queue

Heading **Queue**. Summary: `1 playing` or `Nothing playing`, plus `N up next`.

**Clear all** (shown when something is playing or queued) clears now playing, up-next, **and** the Previous history.

Empty hint refers to card **Watch** and **Queue** actions (the card tooltips are **Watch now** and **Watch later**).

**Now playing:** **Open Play** opens the Play tab. **Stop** clears now playing and navigates to `/play` (it does not by itself clear up-next).

**Up next:** drag the `⋮⋮` handle to reorder. **Watch** plays that item (current video moves to the front of up-next). **Remove** drops it from up-next only. Right-click menu: **Move to front of the queue**, **Move to back of the queue**, **Remove**. Escape or a click outside closes the menu.

If up-next already has 100 items, **Watch later** does nothing and shows no message.

Queue items stay off Home, Search, and Channel until they leave the session.

## Play and mini player

**Play** is a keep-alive tab. On every other tab, the same session is a **bottom-right mini player** (not hidden with `display:none`).

- Mini player chrome: **Expand** (tooltip `Open Play tab`) and **Close player** (clears now playing; if you were on Play, you go Home).
- Overlay **Previous** walks play history. It does not mark watched. The video you leave is put at the front of up-next.
- Overlay **Next** marks watched only when saved progress is at least the watched threshold, then plays up-next. A video marked watched this way is **not** pushed onto play history, so Previous will not return to it. Below the threshold, Next still advances but keeps the video on play history.
- When playback **ends**, the video is always marked watched, it **is** kept on play history (Previous can return), and up-next starts if there is one. If nothing is queued, Replay can show.
- **Replay** resets progress and starts from the beginning. Otherwise opens **resume** from the saved fraction.
- Play-page actions under the title: **Mark watched**, **Hide**, **Open on YouTube** (youtube.com in the browser, using the playable id), **Back to feed**. If the channel is not in the local subscription set: **Subscribe** / **Subscribing…** (local only).
- If the iframe fails: `Player error — try Open on YouTube.`
- Shift-click Watch now opens Play; a normal click stays on the browsing tab with the mini player.

Player settings (cinema, captions, quality, autoplay-on-open) are under Settings → Player. The official YouTube iframe performs playback. MyYouTube does not choose formats or strip ads.

Closing the window asks the renderer to flush progress (about 0.8 seconds, then the window is force-destroyed so a stuck page cannot leave a zombie process). A second close attempt force-quits immediately.

## Saved

Local **collections** (named folders). Not YouTube playlists. No sync to Google.

Left list: type a name (placeholder `Name (e.g. Programming)`) and create. Rename and delete are on the collection. Duplicate names are rejected: `A collection with that name already exists`. Empty name: `Collection name is required`.

Bookmark on a card opens **Save to collection** (checkbox membership, create inline). On the Saved page, the card’s right action is **Remove from this collection**.

## History

Sections:

| Section | What you see | Recovery |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Watched | Marked watched, newest mark first | **Restore (clear watched)** |
| Hidden | Hidden and not watched | **Unhide** returns them to Home/Search |
| All hidden | Every hidden video, including watched | **Unhide** |

Default section when you open History is **Hidden**. Filter box debounces (~280 ms) over title, description, and channel title. **Clear filter** resets it.

Row actions: Watch now, Watch later, Restore or Unhide, **Block channel**.

The list reloads when the tab is shown.

## Account and settings

See [configuration.md](configuration.md). Account is also reachable from the person icon (`/account` opens the Account section). The gear opens Settings and starts on Appearance unless the route is `/account`.

## Keyboard and clicks worth knowing

- Shift-click a card’s watch control: open Play.
- Escape closes the queue context menu.
- There is no documented global shortcut map beyond those controls.

# Configuration — MyYouTube

Version **0.1.17**. Settings are edited in the **Settings** gear (or the account icon, which opens Account). Changes are written to SQLite immediately through serialized settings patches. There is no separate Save button for appearance, player, feed, or filters. Google credentials use an explicit **Save**.

## Where settings live

| Item | Location |
| --- | --- |
| Library and settings JSON | `%APPDATA%\myyoutube\myyoutube.sqlite` (override: `MYYOUTUBE_USER_DATA`) |
| OAuth client id/secret/optional API key | `<userData>/tokens/google-client.json` |
| OAuth tokens | `<userData>/tokens/google-oauth.json` |
| Window size/position | `<userData>/window-state.json` |
| Hardware acceleration boot flag | `<userData>/hardware-acceleration.json` (applied **before** the next launch) |
| Quality debug log | `<userData>/youtube-quality.log` |

Settings rows are inside `application_settings`, not a loose JSON file you edit by hand. Hand-editing the database is unsupported. Back up the whole userData folder before any manual repair.

## Settings sections (exact labels)

Left nav: **Account**, **Provider**, **YouTube provider** title is “YouTube provider”, **Appearance**, **Player**, **Performance**, **Feed**, **Filters**, **Updates**.

### Account — Google account

| Control | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| Client ID | Required with Client Secret. Placeholder looks like `xxxx.apps.googleusercontent.com` |
| Client Secret | Required. Stored in userData, not the repo |
| API key | Optional |
| Save credentials | Persists credentials. Busy label `Saving…`. Success: `Credentials saved. Sign in with Google next.` Switches provider to Live. Disabled until an id and secret are available |
| Clear | Shown once credentials exist. Removes saved client id/secret/API key. Failure text: `Could not clear credentials` |
| Sign in with Google | Opens the system browser. Disabled until credentials are saved. Waiting label: `Waiting for Google…`. The loopback wait is **5 minutes**, then `Sign-in timed out. Try again.` (`auth.timeout`) |
| Sign out | Clears the OAuth session used for API calls. Local videos remain |
| Status line | `Needs credentials`, `Ready to sign in`, or the account label when signed in |
| Help | In-app Google Cloud walkthrough |
| Redirect URI | Shown so you can copy `http://127.0.0.1:17355/callback` into Google Cloud |

Error if you sign in with no credentials: `Add your Google Client ID and Client Secret in Settings first.`

Both id and secret are required together: `Google Client ID and Client Secret are both required.`

### Provider — YouTube provider

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Mock (fixtures) | Offline sample data. No quota |
| Live Data API | Real YouTube Data API v3 using the signed-in token |

Note in the UI: saving Google credentials switches to Live automatically. Mock needs no quota.

### Appearance

| Control | Default |
| --- | --- |
| Theme | `system` (also `light`, `dark`, `custom`) |
| Accent | `#c1121f` |
| Background | `#f7f4f4` |
| Surface | `#ffffff` |
| Muted panel (`sidebar` key) | `#f0eaea` |
| Text | `#1f1416` |
| Muted text | `#6b5a5e` |
| UI font | `Segoe UI, Trebuchet MS, sans-serif` |
| Display font | `Georgia, Palatino Linotype, serif` |
| Font size | 15 px (allowed 12–22) |

Custom colours appear when theme is **custom**. **Reset appearance** restores `DEFAULT_APPEARANCE`. Theme applies immediately in the window.

### Player

| Control | Default | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Mode: Default / Cinema (viewport fit) | Default | Cinema uses full content width under the chrome |
| Autoplay when opening a video | On | Starts playback when you open a video. This is **not** autoplay-next of an endless Home feed |
| Captions on by default | Off | Caption language field default `en` |
| Preferred quality | Auto | Menu labels: Auto, Highest, 1080p, 720p, 480p, 360p, 240p (stored as `auto`, `highres`, `hd1080`, `hd720`, `large`, `medium`, `small`) |

Quality is applied inside the YouTube embed (storage key `yt-player-quality` plus a locked quality range). The parent page’s `setPlaybackQuality` is not relied on. If quality seems stuck, the UI notes hardware acceleration. Failures of YouTube’s own ABR are YouTube’s.

### Performance

**Hardware acceleration** default **on**. Turning it off writes the boot file. The page says restart is required and offers **Restart MyYouTube** (`Restarting…` while it relaunches). The change disables Chromium GPU, including accelerated video decode, for this Electron process (the iframe shares that process). It applies on the next launch, not the moment you untick it. Failure strings: `Could not update GPU setting`, `Could not relaunch`.

### Feed

| Control | Default |
| --- | --- |
| Hide Shorts by default | On |
| Watched threshold | 0.7 (slider clamped to 0.1–1 in the settings UI) |

Home and Channel also have checkboxes **Hide Shorts** and **Unwatched only**. Those write the same settings, so they persist across sessions.

`feedMode` (`chrono` / `ranked` / `priority`) is stored and defaults to `chrono`. The visible feeds always request chronological mode. Ranked scoring is not a user-facing Home mode in this version.

### Filters

- **Blocked channels** — list of channels you marked Blocked. Unblock from here.
- **Keyword filters** — case-insensitive substrings (1–80 characters, up to 100). Matching title or description is excluded from Home and Search. Placeholder example: `spoilers`.

Blocked, muted, or hidden **channels** are excluded from the Home feed. A Channel tab still shows that channel’s local videos even if you are not currently subscribed (single-channel view).

### Updates

| Control | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Updates folder | A directory you choose that contains `MyYouTube Setup *.exe` files |
| Check for updates | Compares installer filenames/versions in that folder with the running app |
| Install | Launches a newer NSIS installer. It does not silently download from the internet |

Errors (exact):

- `Set an updates folder first.`
- `Updates folder not found: …`
- `Installer must be inside the configured updates folder.`
- `Installer file no longer exists.`
- `File is not a recognized MyYouTube installer.`
- `Invalid current app version: …`

There is no cloud auto-update.

## Other persisted session fields

These are not all labelled in Settings, but they survive restart:

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| nowPlaying, playQueue, playHistory | Playback session (queue cap 100, history cap 50) |
| activeChannel | The open Channel tab until you press Close |
| lastRoute | Restored on launch (path and query, max 500 characters) |
| searchHistory | Up to 25 recent queries kept in the UI (schema max 40) |
| sidebarCollapsed | Stored; the current UI is a top tab bar, not a left sidebar |
| unwatchedOnly | Persisted |

Session-only (lost on restart): `omittedDiscoveryIds` (videos you hid or marked not-watching this session, so in-flight loads cannot put them back). The database `hidden` / `completed` flags are what persist.

## Environment variables

| Variable | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `MYYOUTUBE_USER_DATA` | Absolute path for the profile directory |
| `MYTUBE_USER_DATA` | Legacy alias |
| `ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL` | Dev only: load the renderer from Vite instead of the local http server |
| `CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY` | Set `false` by the `dist` script so packaging does not look for a code-signing cert |

## Defaults that surprise people

- Hide Shorts **on**.
- Unwatched only **off** until you tick it (then it stays on).
- Provider **mock** until you save Google credentials.
- Hardware acceleration **on** until you turn it off and restart.
- Home **Refresh** does not call YouTube.

# Technical reference — MyYouTube

Version **0.1.17**. This is how the program behaves, not a second copy of Google’s API reference.

## Versions and compatibility

- `package.json` `version` is the app version baked into builds.
- `npm run dist` runs `bump:patch` **before** packaging, so a dist build’s version is one patch above the commit you started from unless you account for that.
- Windows NSIS is the only packaged target (`appId` `com.myyoutube.app`).
- Behaviour below is this source tree. Do not assume a 0.1.0 installer matches Channel Refresh or the sync safety rules.

## Navigation routes

| Route | Screen |
| --- | --- |
| `/` | Home / Personal feed |
| `/subscriptions` | Subscriptions |
| `/search?q=` | Search |
| `/channel/:id` | Channel tab |
| `/history` | History |
| `/saved` | Saved collections |
| `/queue` | Queue |
| `/play` and `/watch/:videoId` | Play |
| `/account` | Settings, Account section |
| `/settings` | Settings (opens on Appearance) |

Last route is restored from settings before the first Home fetch.

## Feed query

IPC `feed.query`. Page size requested by Home and Channel: **24** (schema allows 1–50).

SQL order: `published_at DESC, id DESC`. Cursor: `publishedAt|id`.

Home (no channel id) requires: video not hidden; channel subscribed, not blocked, not muted, not hidden.

Channel id set: video not hidden and `channel_id` matches. Subscription flag is **not** required.

Optional filters:

- Hide Shorts: `is_short` is null or 0.
- Unwatched only: `watch_history.completed` is not 1, **and** `watch_progress` is null or **below** `watchedThreshold`.
- Keyword: `INSTR` of lowercased keyword in title and description must be 0.
- Exclude ids: now playing, play queue, and ids the renderer sends (same set).

Short inference when the provider omits the flag: duration ≤ **60** seconds.

`matchingTotal` counts rows matching filters. `libraryTotal` counts videos on subscribed channels. Home shows those numbers.

Response `mode` echoes the request. Callers send `chrono`. `source` is always `subscriptions` even for a single channel.

## Sync quotas (this app’s choices, not Google’s price list)

| Action | YouTube calls (shape) |
| --- | --- |
| Subscriptions → Sync | `subscriptions.list` mine=true, 50/page, all pages; then per channel `channels.list` if uploads playlist id is unknown; `playlistItems` **2** pages, 50 each; `videos.list` for those ids |
| Channel → Refresh | channel details + **5** playlist pages |
| Subscribe from a video | channel details + **3** playlist pages |
| Home → Refresh | **none** (local SQL) |
| Search submit / uncached Load more | **one** `search.list` (max 50) plus `videos.list`. Further pages only if already in `search_cache` and younger than **6 hours**, at most **10** cached fill pages after the live call |

Concurrent syncs: error code `busy`.

Upload failures: sync continues; `failedChannels` and up to 8 `failures` strings (`Channel title: message`).

## Watched and hidden

- Progress is 0–1. Completed when explicitly marked or when progress ≥ threshold (default 0.7). Settings UI clamps the slider to 0.1–1.
- **Next** uses that threshold and does **not** add the finished item to play history when it marks watched.
- **Ended** always completes and **does** push the video onto play history before starting up-next (`finishCurrentAndPlayNext`).
- **Previous** does not complete. The video you leave is inserted at the front of up-next.
- Hide sets `hidden = 1` and `hidden_at`. Unhide clears both. Hide does not call YouTube.
- Session omit list is memory-only in the renderer store.

## Queue limits

- Up-next max **100**. **Watch later** past that limit is ignored with no dialog.
- **Watch now** moves the previous now-playing item to the front of up-next (it is not discarded).
- **Clear all** on Queue clears now playing, up-next, and play history. **Stop** on the now-playing row clears only now playing, then opens `/play`.
- Play history max **50** (most recent last).
- Search history UI cap **25** (stored array schema max 40).
- Discovery exclude list sent by the renderer is capped by schema at **150** ids.

## Playback

- Official IFrame Player script from YouTube. Packaged UI origin is `http://127.0.0.1` on an ephemeral port (`RendererServer`), not `file://`.
- Preferred quality is written into the embed’s `yt-player-quality` and locked with `setPlaybackQualityRange(target, target)`. Log: `userData/youtube-quality.log`.
- Close: renderer flush, then main force-destroys the window after **800 ms** if flush has not finished. Second close force-quits.

## OAuth

- Redirect: `http://127.0.0.1:17355/callback` (fixed port).
- PKCE. Scope string includes openid, email, profile, and `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.readonly`.
- Access token refresh uses the stored refresh token. Failures surface as `Failed to refresh Google access token`.
- Secrets are not logged by policy. Do not add logging of tokens.

## Error codes (IPC `error.code` when set)

| Code | Typical message |
| --- | --- |
| `auth.timeout` | Sign-in timed out after 5 minutes |
| `auth.invalidCallback` | Invalid OAuth callback |
| `api.notConfigured` | YouTube Data API v3 is not enabled… |
| `api.quota` | Quota exceeded (search bucket called out separately) |
| `api.forbidden` | subscriptionForbidden, insufficientPermissions, or other 403 |
| `api.notFound` | Missing channel, video, or collection |
| `api.network` | Other HTTP failure from YouTube |
| `busy` | Sync already running |
| `validation` | Zod or empty collection name |
| `updates.noFolder` | Set an updates folder first |
| `updates.launchFailed` | Installer could not be opened |
| `internal` | Uncoded exception |

The renderer shows `error.message` to the user.

## Collections

Names unique case-insensitively. Videos must already exist in `videos` to be saved. Deleting a collection cascades membership, not the video row.

## Migrations

SQLite migrations in `src/main/db/migrations.ts` run at startup. Applied ids are stored in `schema_migrations`. The app does not expose a downgrade. Copy the database file before experimenting with schema.

## IPC shape

Every invoke returns `{ ok: true, value }` or `{ ok: false, error: { code, message } }`. Channel names live in `src/shared/ipc/channels.ts`. The renderer never gets Node or the database.

## Mock provider

Fixture channels and videos in `src/main/youtube/fixtures.ts`. Upload pages are 5 items. Search filters fixtures by title, description, and channel title. No network.

<!-- source: docs/troubleshooting.md -->

# Troubleshooting — MyYouTube

Version **0.1.17**. Prefer the least destructive check first. Do not delete `%APPDATA%\myyoutube` unless you accept losing the library, tokens, queue, and settings. Copy that folder somewhere else before you remove it.

## Personal feed is empty or “not up to date”

**Symptom:** Home shows little or nothing, or videos are older than YouTube.

**Causes:**

- Provider is Mock (fixtures only) or you are not signed in.
- **Subscriptions → Sync** has never completed. Home **Refresh** does not call YouTube.
- Sync only stores about the newest **100** uploads per channel (2×50). Older videos are absent until you open that channel and press **Refresh** (up to 5 playlist pages).
- Hide Shorts and/or Unwatched only filtered them out. The subtitle `N cached · M match filters` shows this.
- Channel is muted, blocked, or locally unsubscribed.
- Keyword filter matched the title or description.
- Video is hidden, watched above the threshold, or sitting in the queue / now playing (those are hidden from Discovery on purpose).

**Checks:**

1. Settings → Provider is **Live Data API**, and the account icon shows you signed in.
2. Subscriptions lists the channel. If not, run **Sync subscriptions** and wait until the button is idle.
3. Turn off **Unwatched only** and **Hide Shorts** on Home.
4. Settings → Filters: remove keywords; unblock the channel.
5. History → Hidden / Watched: Unhide or Restore if you dismissed it.
6. Queue: remove it from up-next if you expected it on Home.
7. Open the channel and press **Refresh**.

**Expected:** Home subtitle counts rise and cards appear. Sync can take many minutes; the button text should change (`Uploads i/n`).

## Stuck on “Loading more…” or the window stops responding

**Symptom:** Channel or Home stays on `Loading more…`, or the UI repaints but clicks and close do nothing.

**Causes:** An empty filtered page used to request the next page forever. Current builds stop after **8** consecutive pages with nothing visible (`No more videos match your filters…`). A frozen renderer can still delay quit.

**Checks:**

1. Update to a build that includes the 8-page cap (0.1.x line that matches this document).
2. Turn off Unwatched only.
3. If the window is frozen: click close once (force-destroy after ~0.8 s). Click close again to force quit immediately. If the OS already killed the window and a process remains, end **MyYouTube** / **electron** in Task Manager. In `npm run dev`, a Node/Electron parent can remain in the terminal after the window dies; stop that terminal job separately.
4. Do not delete the database as a first step.

**Expected:** Either cards, a Load more button, or the filters-exhausted message. The process exits after close.

## Hide does nothing or the card comes back

**Symptom:** Eye-off hide appears to no-op, or the card returns.

**Causes:**

- An in-flight page load used to overwrite the list. Hides are session-omitted and also written as `hidden = 1`. Merges drop hidden and omitted ids.
- If the database update fails, an alert shows the error. The card may already have left the list for this session only.
- **Not watching** (check) marks watched; it is not the same as hide. With Unwatched only off, a watched video can still appear unless you also hid it.
- Restart clears the session omit list. Persistence is the database flag. Confirm under History → Hidden.

**Expected:** Card leaves Discovery and appears under History → Hidden. Unhide restores it.

## Sync feels empty or channels vanish mid-sync

**Symptom:** During sync, subscriptions disappear or Home is blank, then maybe recovers.

**Cause (older builds):** all channels were marked unsubscribed before the import finished. Current sync saves the YouTube list first, then uploads, and only then reconciles removals. Local-only subscribed channels are kept.

**Checks:** Wait until sync finishes. If a channel is missing afterward, it was not on the YouTube subscription list and was not a local-only add — or you had locally unsubscribed. Sign-in must be the YouTube identity that owns the subscriptions (brand accounts). Error: `Google denied subscription access. Sign out, sign in again, and pick the YouTube channel that owns those subscriptions (brand accounts can differ from the Gmail login).`

## Sign-in and API errors

| Message | Meaning | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Add your Google Client ID and Client Secret in Settings first.` | No credentials saved | Settings → Account → Save both fields |
| `Google Client ID and Client Secret are both required.` | One field empty | Fill both |
| `Not signed in to Google` / `YouTube auth expired — sign in again.` | No token or HTTP 401 | Sign in again |
| `Sign-in timed out. Try again.` | Browser flow exceeded the wait | Retry; allow `http://127.0.0.1:17355/callback` |
| `Invalid OAuth callback` | Callback was not the expected code exchange | Retry; check the redirect URI |
| `Failed to refresh Google access token` | Refresh token rejected | Sign out and sign in again |
| `YouTube Data API v3 is not enabled…` | API disabled on the Cloud project | Enable it, wait a minute, sync again. https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/library/youtube.googleapis.com |
| `YouTube search quota exceeded for today…` | `search.list` daily cap (often ~100/project) | Use cached searches; resets midnight Pacific Time. Feed sync does not use search |
| `YouTube API quota exceeded for today…` | General Data API quota | Wait for Pacific midnight reset. Avoid repeated full syncs |
| `Missing YouTube permission…` | Token lacks `youtube.readonly` | Sign out and sign in, grant the scope |
| `YouTube API forbidden (path): …` | Other 403 | Read the detail. Often Cloud project, quota, or identity |
| `Channel not found: …` | API returned no channel | Id is wrong or removed |
| `A subscription sync is already running…` | Second sync | Wait |

Token exchange failures surface as `Token exchange failed: …` (Google’s body). That is a Google OAuth problem (wrong secret, redirect mismatch, or consent).

## Search returns nothing or burns quota

**Symptom:** Search is empty, or you hit the search quota message.

**Causes:** Each new query and each uncached Load more costs one search unit. Cache lasts 6 hours and is keyed by the exact lowercased query. Unwatched only can hide every hit on a page; the app may walk cached pages only after the first live call. Keywords and the queue exclude hits. Mock provider searches fixtures only.

**Checks:** Settings → Provider is Live. Repeat the same query within 6 hours (should be cached). Turn off Unwatched only. Do not mash Search.

## Playback problems

| Symptom | Likely side | Action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Black player, YouTube error 153 in a packaged build | Origin was `file://` in old builds | Current packaged app serves the UI at `http://127.0.0.1:<port>`. Update the app |
| `Timed out loading YouTube IFrame API` / `YouTube IFrame API failed to initialize` / `Failed to load YouTube IFrame API script` | Network or YouTube script blocked | Check firewall/DNS. MyYouTube does not host the player |
| `Player error — try Open on YouTube.` | The embed reported an error | Play page → **Open on YouTube**. Quality and ads are still YouTube’s |
| Quality stays low | YouTube ABR, or GPU off | Settings → Player quality; Performance → hardware acceleration (restart). See `userData/youtube-quality.log` |
| Starts at 0 though you watched some | Progress not flushed, or Replay | Close once so flush runs. Replay intentionally restarts |
| Mini player missing | Nothing in now playing | Watch now on a card |
| Next did not mark watched | Progress under threshold | Settings → Feed threshold, or watch further. End of video always marks watched |

## Updates

**Symptom:** Check says no folder, or install refuses the file.

Use Settings → Updates, pick the folder that actually contains `MyYouTube Setup <version>.exe`, then Check. Install only launches that local file. It will not download a build for you. The installer must sit inside the configured folder.

## Window or process left behind

See the freeze section. Dev mode: closing the window does not always stop `npm run dev`; use the terminal. Installed app: after the force-destroy path, `window-all-closed` quits and closes SQLite.

## Database / “corrupt” library

**Symptom:** App will not start, or lists are nonsense after a crash.

SQLite uses WAL (`myyoutube.sqlite-wal` / `-shm` may exist). Do not delete `-wal` while the app is running.

**Safe recovery:**

1. Quit MyYouTube (Task Manager if needed).
2. Copy the entire `%APPDATA%\myyoutube` folder to a backup.
3. Start again. If it still fails, rename `myyoutube.sqlite` (and wal/shm) aside and start — you get an **empty** library. Tokens in `tokens\` can be left in place. You will need **Sync** to refill videos. Watch history in the old file is not merged automatically. There is no in-app import of a renamed database.

## What to send in a bug report

GitHub issues: https://github.com/MeaningfulnessMediaGroup/MyYoutube/issues

Include: app version (Settings → Updates shows the running version), Windows version, provider Mock or Live, the **exact** error text, and what you expected. Do **not** paste client secrets, refresh tokens, `google-oauth.json`, or `google-client.json`. Redact personal channel lists if they are private. A screenshot of the message is enough. There is no support desk and no response-time promise.

<!-- source: docs/app-architecture.md -->

# How the app is put together — MyYouTube

This is the support-level architecture. The longer engineering note remains [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md). If they disagree, the source tree wins.

## Processes

```text
Renderer (React, Zustand, no Node)
    → preload contextBridge window.myyoutube
    → Electron main
         → SQLite (better-sqlite3)
         → Google OAuth + YouTube Data API v3
         → local http server for the packaged UI
         → official YouTube IFrame (loaded by the renderer)
```

Main owns tokens, API calls, the database, sync, and settings. The renderer owns screens and asks main through typed IPC validated with Zod.

## Startup

1. Optional `.env.local` / `.env` loaded if keys are unset.
2. `userData` path resolved (`MYYOUTUBE_USER_DATA` or `%APPDATA%\myyoutube`, with the legacy product-name fallback).
3. Hardware-acceleration boot file applied **before** `app.ready`.
4. Database migrations, token store, credential store, window state.
5. IPC handlers registered.
6. Window restored from `window-state.json`.
7. Packaged builds: `RendererServer` on `127.0.0.1:0`. Dev: `ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL`.
8. Renderer bootstraps settings and auth, restores hash route, then mounts tabs.

## Feed data flow

YouTube subscriptions and playlist items are **copied** into `channels` and `videos`. Home reads SQL. Sync is explicit (Subscriptions). Channel Refresh updates one channel’s recent uploads. Nothing in the feed path inserts “recommended” videos that are not from that import or from search.

Search writes `search_cache` (ids plus page token, 6-hour TTL) and upserts video rows so cards can render offline afterward.

## Playback data flow

Watch now writes `nowPlaying` and shifts the previous item according to queue rules in the renderer store, then persists settings. Progress events go to `watch_history`. The iframe is YouTube’s. MyYouTube stores a fraction of duration, not a downloaded file.

## Shutdown

`close` is intercepted once so the renderer can flush playback and the current route. After 800 ms, or on a second close, the window is `destroy()`ed. `window-all-closed` stops the renderer server, closes SQLite, and quits (non-macOS).

## Security boundary

- Renderer sandbox is configured with context isolation and **nodeIntegration: false**. Preload is not sandboxed (`sandbox: false` on the preload bridge) so IPC can be exposed. The page itself has no Node.
- Tokens never go to the renderer except as “signed in” status and an account label.
- External links open with `shell.openExternal`.
- OAuth loopback is `127.0.0.1` only.

## External systems

| System | Role |
| --- | --- |
| YouTube Data API v3 | Subscriptions, channel uploads, video details, search |
| Google OAuth | Identity and refreshable access token |
| YouTube IFrame Player | Playback only |
| Electron / Chromium | Window, GPU, autoplay policies |
| NSIS (electron-builder) | Windows installer the app can launch from a folder you choose |

See the responsibility tables in the consolidated support guide’s integration section (also summarized in [getting-started.md](getting-started.md)).

# Development — MyYouTube

Version **0.1.17**. Contributors: also read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md), [DECISIONS.md](DECISIONS.md), and [PLAN.md](../PLAN.md).

## Requirements

- Node.js 20+ and npm.
- Windows is the packaged target. `npm run dev` uses Electron and can run on the developer’s OS.
- Python/build tools may be required to compile `better-sqlite3` for the installed Electron ABI (`postinstall` runs `electron-builder install-app-deps`).

## Commands

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `npm install` | Dependencies and native module rebuild |
| `npm run dev` | electron-vite dev server |
| `npm run build` | Production bundle in `out/` |
| `npm run preview` | Preview the production bundle |
| `npm run typecheck` | `tsc` for main and renderer |
| `npm test` | Vitest once |
| `npm run lint` | ESLint, zero warnings |
| `npm run format` | Prettier on `src` |
| `npm run dist` | Patch bump, build, unsigned NSIS into `release/`, delete older installers |
| `npm run icons` | Regenerate icons (PowerShell) |
| `npm run docs:bundle` | Rebuild root `AI-SUPPORT.md` from `docs/` sources |
| `npm run docs:check` | Fail if `AI-SUPPORT.md` does not match sources (does not rewrite files) |

Isolated profile: set `MYYOUTUBE_USER_DATA` before `npm run dev`.

## Layout

- `src/main` — Electron main, SQLite, YouTube, auth, IPC.
- `src/preload` — `window.myyoutube`.
- `src/renderer` — React routes.
- `src/shared` — Zod schemas and IPC channel names (imported by all sides).
- `docs/` — product specs **and** the support set listed in [README.md](README.md).
- User databases must not be committed.

## Tests

Vitest covers narrow units (for example duration/shorts helpers, update version parsing, YouTube error mapping). There is no full Electron UI test harness in-repo. Do not treat a green `npm test` as proof of sync or player behaviour.

## Changing behaviour

Update the matching support doc in the same change:

- UI label or flow → `docs/user-guide.md` and `docs/FAQ.md`.
- Setting or default → `docs/configuration.md`.
- Error string → `docs/troubleshooting.md` and `docs/reference.md`.
- IPC or limits → `docs/reference.md`.
- Then `npm run docs:bundle`.

Product locks live in `docs/DECISIONS.md`. Do not add discovery injection, stream extraction, or renderer Node access.

## Packaging notes

`npm run dist` sets `CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false`. Installers are unsigned. `scripts/afterPack.mjs` runs after pack. `scripts/clean-old-releases.mjs` removes older setup exes. Output name looks like `release/MyYouTube Setup 0.1.x.exe`.

## Support docs bundle

Source order is fixed in `scripts/bundle-ai-support.mjs`. Do not hand-edit `AI-SUPPORT.md` except by changing those sources and rebundling. `docs/support-evaluation.md` is **not** bundled (maintainer-only).

# FAQ — MyYouTube

Version **0.1.17**. Answers match the app, not YouTube’s website.

## Basics

### What is MyYouTube?

A Windows desktop client that keeps a local chronological library of subscription uploads and plays them with YouTube’s official player. It is not YouTube Home and it is not affiliated with Google.

### Which version is this FAQ about?

**0.1.17** as recorded in `package.json`. If Settings → Updates shows a different version, behaviour can differ. Say your version when you ask for help.

### Where do I download it?

The repository builds `release/MyYouTube Setup <version>.exe` with `npm run dist`. There is no in-app cloud download. GitHub: https://github.com/MeaningfulnessMediaGroup/MyYoutube

### Does it work on Mac or Linux?

Packaging is Windows NSIS only. Running from source depends on Electron. There is no supported Mac/Linux installer in this version.

### Is it affiliated with YouTube?

No. YouTube is a trademark of Google. Playback and metadata use official APIs.

### Does it download videos?

No. No stream URLs, no files to play offline, no ad removal.

## Installation and accounts

### How do I run it without a Google account?

Settings → Provider → **Mock (fixtures)**. Home → Refresh shows sample videos. This is the default until you save Google credentials.

### How do I use my real subscriptions?

Settings → Account: save Client ID and Client Secret, sign in, then **Subscriptions → Sync subscriptions**. Enable YouTube Data API v3 on that Cloud project and use a **Desktop app** OAuth client. Redirect URI: `http://127.0.0.1:17355/callback`.

### Where do I get a Client ID?

Google Cloud Console credentials: https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials — create an OAuth client, type Desktop app. MyYouTube does not issue client ids.

### Do I need an API key?

No. It is optional. OAuth client id and secret are what sign-in uses.

### Why did saving credentials change Mock to Live?

By design. The UI says saving Google credentials switches to Live. Switch back to Mock if you want fixtures.

### What permissions does sign-in request?

`youtube.readonly` plus OpenID email and profile. The app cannot subscribe, unsubscribe, like, or upload on YouTube’s side.

### Sign-in timed out. What now?

Message: `Sign-in timed out. Try again.` Finish the browser consent. Confirm the redirect URI. Do not block `127.0.0.1`.

### Which Google account’s subscriptions are imported?

The account you pick in the browser. Brand accounts can differ from the Gmail login. If Google returns `subscriptionForbidden`, the app says to sign out, sign in again, and pick the channel that owns the subscriptions.

### Where are my tokens stored?

`<userData>/tokens/google-oauth.json` and credentials in `google-client.json`. Normally `%APPDATA%\myyoutube\tokens\`. Never paste these into issues.

### How do I sign out?

Settings → Account → sign out. Local videos remain. API calls stop until you sign in again.

## Home and sync

### How do I refresh new uploads?

**Subscriptions → Sync subscriptions** for every channel (about the newest 100 videos each). **Channel → Refresh** for one channel (deeper, 5 playlist pages). **Home → Refresh** only reloads what is already in the database.

### Why does Home Refresh finish instantly and change nothing?

It does not call YouTube. Run Sync, or Channel Refresh.

### Why doesn’t a huge channel show its whole catalogue?

Bulk sync stores 2 pages of 50 playlist items per channel. Channel Refresh stores up to 5 pages per click. There is no “download entire channel” control.

### What does the line “1200 cached · 40 match filters · showing 24” mean?

`cached` is videos on subscribed channels in SQLite. `match filters` applies Hide Shorts, Unwatched only, keywords, and exclusions. `showing` is how many cards are on screen after Discovery filters (queue, hidden, watched threshold).

### Why did a video disappear when I queued it?

Discovery (Home, Search, Channel) hides now-playing and up-next. Open **Queue**. Remove it from the queue if you want it back on Home.

### What is the difference between Hide and Not watching?

**Not watching** (check) marks the video watched. **Not watching (hide)** (eye) sets hidden so it leaves the feed even if Unwatched only is off. Both can be undone from History (Restore vs Unhide).

### Can I undo hide?

History → Hidden or All hidden → **Unhide**. That clears `hidden` in the database.

### Can I undo watched?

History → Watched → **Restore (clear watched)**.

### Why are Shorts missing?

**Hide Shorts** defaults on, on Home, Channel, and Settings → Feed. A Short is duration ≤ 60 seconds when the API did not send a better flag. Turn the checkbox off to see them.

### What does Unwatched only do?

Hides videos with completed watch history or progress at or above the threshold (default 70%). It also treats queued items as not part of Discovery. The checkbox is saved.

### Why does “Loading more…” stop with “No more videos match your filters”?

The app will automatically walk at most **8** local pages that produce zero visible cards, then stop so it cannot freeze. Relax filters or sync more uploads.

### The window froze and Task Manager still shows the process.

Close once (the app force-destroys the window after about 0.8 seconds). Close again to force quit. End the process if the OS already detached the window. In development, also stop `npm run dev`. Your library is in userData; killing the process does not delete it, but the last second of playback might not have flushed.

### Sync says it is already running.

`A subscription sync is already running. Wait for it to finish, or check Subscriptions.` Only one sync at a time. Watch the button phase text.

### Some channels failed during sync but others imported.

That is intentional. The summary can include per-channel errors. Those channels stay on the subscription list. Open a failed channel and Refresh, or sync again later. Quota or a deleted channel are typical causes.

### I unsubscribed inside MyYouTube but YouTube still shows the subscription.

Correct. Unsubscribe is local only. YouTube is unchanged.

### I subscribed from a video. Did I subscribe on YouTube?

No. The Play page control says `Add to MyYouTube subscriptions (YouTube subscription unchanged)`. It fetches that channel into the local database.

### Does Favourite change the feed order?

No. Home stays newest-first. Favourite, Muted, and Blocked are preference flags. Muted and Blocked remove the channel from Home. Favourite does not sort.

### What is Normal?

It clears favourite, muted, and blocked on that channel.

## Channel tab

### How do I open a channel?

Click the channel name on a card, or a row on Subscriptions. A channel icon appears in the tab bar. Only one channel tab exists; opening another replaces it.

### How do I close the channel tab?

**Close** on the channel page. The icon disappears. The choice is remembered until then, including across restarts.

### The channel page is empty but YouTube has videos.

Those videos are not in the local library yet, or filters hid them. Press **Refresh** on the channel page (this one talks to YouTube). Turn off Hide Shorts and Unwatched only. If the API errors, the red message is the reason (quota, auth, not found).

## Search

### Does search run while I type?

No. Submit the form or press the Search button. The top bar works the same way.

### Why did search stop working today?

`YouTube search quota exceeded for today (default ~100 search.list calls/day per Google Cloud project).` Resets midnight Pacific Time. Repeating a query within **6 hours** uses the local cache and does not spend another unit. Home sync does not use the search quota.

### What does Load more cost?

One `search.list` if that page is not cached. After a live page, extra fill only walks cache (up to 10 cached pages) and stops around 24 videos that pass the local filters. If the batch is empty but a next page exists, the button reads **Keep scanning** and the message says to load more to keep scanning.

### Why does search say results are in History?

The Search page and the top bar have a dropdown labelled like recent queries (`Recent queries appear in History`). That is search history, not the History tab of watched and hidden videos.

### Are search results mixed into Home?

No. Home is subscriptions only.

## Queue and playback

### How do I watch without leaving the page?

Click **Watch now** (play icon or thumbnail). A mini player opens at the bottom right.

### How do I open the big player?

Shift-click Watch now, press **Expand** on the mini player (tooltip `Open Play tab`), or use the Play icon. On the Queue page, **Open Play** does the same for the current item.

### What does Close player do?

Clears now playing. If you were on the Play tab, you return Home.

### What is the difference between Previous and Next?

**Previous** goes back through play history and does not mark watched. **Next** marks watched only if progress ≥ the threshold, then plays the next queued item. When the video ends, it is always marked watched and the next item starts.

### Why did Next not count as watched?

Progress was under Settings → Feed threshold (default 0.7). Watch further or lower the threshold. **Not watching** (check) on Home or Channel always marks watched. Search cards do not have that check; use Play → **Mark watched**. **Next** only records watched when progress is already at the threshold, and that video is then omitted from play history. A video that plays to the end is always marked watched and **can** be reached with **Previous**.

### It restarted from the beginning.

If you pressed **Replay**, that is intended (finished videos resume via Replay, not from a stale end position). Otherwise progress may not have flushed before a crash. Normal opens resume the saved fraction.

### Autoplay when opening a video — does the feed autoplay?

No. Settings → Player → **Autoplay when opening a video** starts the embed you opened. It does not autoplay down Home. There is no infinite-scroll autoplay.

### Cinema mode looks different.

Settings → Player → Mode → **Cinema (viewport fit)** uses the full width under the top bar. **Default** is the other layout.

### Quality will not stick.

MyYouTube writes a preferred quality into the YouTube embed and locks the range. YouTube can still fail. Check Settings → Performance → hardware acceleration (needs restart). Log file: `%APPDATA%\myyoutube\youtube-quality.log`. Further quality behaviour is YouTube’s player, not this app.

### The player says error 153.

Older packaged builds loaded the UI from `file://`, which YouTube rejects. Current builds serve the UI on `http://127.0.0.1`. Update the app. If you still see it, record the version.

### The iframe script timed out.

`Timed out loading YouTube IFrame API` means the YouTube script did not load. Check the network. MyYouTube cannot play video without it.

## Saved and history

### Are collections YouTube playlists?

No. They are local names in SQLite. They do not sync to Google. Deleting a collection does not delete videos from YouTube or from the video table.

### Why can’t I save a video?

The video row must exist locally (it appeared on a card). Error `Video not found` means it is not in the database. Duplicate collection names: `A collection with that name already exists`.

### How do I remove a save without hiding the video?

Saved tab → **Remove from this collection**. That is not Hide.

### History opened on Hidden, not Watched.

That is the default section. Choose **Watched** or **All hidden** in the left column.

### Filter on History matches what?

Title, description, and channel title, case-insensitive, after a short debounce. **Clear filter** resets it.

### Block channel from History — what happens?

The channel preference becomes blocked (and hidden as a channel). Its videos leave Home. Unblock under Settings → Filters.

## Settings

### Where are settings on disk?

Inside `%APPDATA%\myyoutube\myyoutube.sqlite`, plus token files and `hardware-acceleration.json`. Override the folder with `MYYOUTUBE_USER_DATA`.

### Do dev and the installed app share data?

Yes, if they use the same userData path. Use `MYYOUTUBE_USER_DATA` to separate them.

### I turned off hardware acceleration and nothing changed.

It applies on the **next launch**. Restart the app.

### How do updates work?

Settings → Updates → choose a folder that already contains newer `MyYouTube Setup *.exe` files → Check → Install. Nothing is downloaded from the internet. Errors include `Set an updates folder first.` and `File is not a recognized MyYouTube installer.`

### What is the watched threshold?

Settings → Feed. Default 0.7. Progress at or above it counts as watched for Unwatched only and for the player’s Next button. The slider does not go below 0.1.

### Keyword filter “spoilers” hid too much.

Filters are substrings of title **or** description, case-insensitive. A short word can match a lot. Remove it under Settings → Filters.

## Data safety

### How do I back up?

Quit the app. Copy `%APPDATA%\myyoutube` (or your override path). Include `tokens` if you do not want to sign in again. Treat the copy as secret.

### How do I start fresh without losing the backup?

Quit, rename the folder, start the app, sign in, Sync. The old folder remains as your backup. There is no merge tool.

### Will reinstalling wipe my library?

No. The installer does not store the library in Program Files. Uninstalling might, depending on Windows uninstall options — back up userData first if you care. This document cannot see a specific uninstaller checkbox beyond “data lives in userData”.

### Can two copies run at once?

They would share one SQLite file unless userData is overridden. That risks database locks. Use one instance per profile.

## Failures

### YouTube Data API v3 is not enabled.

Enable it: https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/library/youtube.googleapis.com then wait a minute and sync again.

### Quota exceeded but I did not search.

Non-search message: `YouTube API quota exceeded for today. Try again tomorrow (resets midnight Pacific Time).` Subscription listing and video details spend the general quota. Searching spends a separate search budget. Both are Google’s.

### Auth expired.

`YouTube auth expired — sign in again.` The refresh token may also fail (`Failed to refresh Google access token`). Sign out and sign in.

### Channel not found.

The id is unknown to the API (`Channel not found: …`). The channel may have been deleted.

## Development

### How do I build from source?

Node 20+, `npm install`, `npm run dev`. Tests: `npm test`. Package: `npm run dist` (bumps the patch version).

### Where do I report a bug?

https://github.com/MeaningfulnessMediaGroup/MyYoutube/issues — version, exact error text, expected vs actual. No secrets. No guaranteed response time.

# Roadmap — MyYouTube

Version **0.1.17**. Only items grounded in the repository’s decisions and README are listed. Undated ideas are not commitments.

## Implemented in this version

- Electron shell, SQLite, mock and live YouTube providers.
- Google OAuth (desktop loopback, PKCE, `youtube.readonly`).
- Subscription sync with progress, local unsubscribe, channel preferences.
- Chronological Home from the local cache; Channel tab with a deeper refresh.
- Explicit search with a 6-hour cache and a one-live-call-per-action quota guard.
- Hide, watched threshold, keyword filters, blocked channels.
- Queue, Play, mini player, resume, Replay, Previous/Next.
- Saved collections (local only).
- History (watched / hidden / all hidden).
- Appearance themes, player options, hardware-acceleration toggle (restart).
- Local NSIS update check/install from a folder you choose.
- Windows installer build script.

## Known limitations (not bugs by themselves)

- Bulk sync keeps only about the newest 100 uploads per channel. Older catalogue needs Channel → Refresh, and even that is capped at 5 playlist pages per click.
- Home is chronological only. `ranked` and `priority` feed modes are stored but not what the screens request.
- Favourite does not reorder Home.
- Collections do not sync to YouTube playlists.
- No download, no offline video files, no ad blocking.
- Search quota is Google’s daily search budget, shared by the Cloud project.
- Hardware acceleration changes apply on next launch.
- Unsigned Windows installer.
- No first-class macOS/Linux packages.

## Explicitly deferred (docs/DECISIONS.md)

- Cloud sync of MyYouTube preferences.
- YouTube playlist sync for collections.
- Local LLM / embedding provider.
- Shorts detection beyond the duration heuristic.

## Not planned unless a decision says so

Do not assume multi-account switching, comments, live chat, SponsorBlock, or a “recommended” home row. They are not in the shipping UI.
